title: CyberSuivi GAT
subtitle: Cybersecurity awareness tracking platform with BI dashboards and phishing-risk prediction
context: Final-year engineering project (PFE) carried out at GAT Assurances in Tunis to track cybersecurity awareness across the company.
problem: Before CyberSuivi, awareness data lived in scattered Excel files: the company had no view of its overall security posture and no way to spot the employees most at risk of phishing.
solution: Built a full-stack platform with React and NestJS, including JWT authentication and role-based access control.
Designed the ETL with Power Query and the data model behind the reporting layer.
Developed Power BI dashboards with DAX measures and KPIs for quizzes, trainings, phishing campaigns and vulnerabilities.
Developed a Machine Learning model that predicts each employee's phishing risk.
Developed an AI-based cybersecurity chatbot and a cyber-watch module.
result: Final-year project graduated with Très Bien (Very Good) honors.

showcase.tagline: A cybersecurity awareness platform that turns training, quiz and phishing data into strategic decisions and individual risk predictions.

title: ADMISSITY
subtitle: BI platform for admissions and graduate employability
problem: Applicant and alumni data was scattered, and the school could not track the employability of its graduates.
solution: Centralized applicant and alumni data in a single platform.
Built predictive models and KPI dashboards.
Developed a job recommendation feature for graduates, based on CV analysis and LinkedIn scraping.
pitch: Applicant and alumni data centralized in a single platform.
Job recommendations from CV analysis and LinkedIn scraping.

title: ANYPLI Car Rental Platform
subtitle: Car rental platform with a REST API and Power BI dashboards
context: Summer internship project at ANYPLI in Monastir: design and development of a car rental platform.
solution: Designed and developed the car rental platform: backend with NestJS, frontend with React, TypeScript and Material UI.
Managed application state with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query.
Built a REST API with JWT authentication on a MySQL database using TypeORM.
Created data analysis reports and dashboards with Power BI.
pitch: NestJS backend with a REST API, JWT authentication and MySQL through TypeORM.
React, TypeScript and Material UI frontend with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query.
Power BI reports and dashboards for data analysis.

title: ANYPLI Real-Time News Website
subtitle: Real-time news website organized by category
context: Summer internship project at ANYPLI in Monastir.
problem: Readers had no single place to follow real-time news by category.
solution: Built a real-time news website with React and TypeScript, with categories for Sport, Health, General, BBC News and BBC Sport.
Integrated NewsAPI and managed application state with Redux.
Designed a responsive interface with Material UI.
pitch: Real-time news website built with React and TypeScript.
NewsAPI integration with application state managed in Redux.
Responsive Material UI interface organized by category.
